svg.title: Duong Thai Tan, full-stack developer
svg.desc: Terminal-style hero framed like a camera viewfinder. The command whoami types out and the name Duong Thai Tan, in brushed metal, rises into view while a sheen of light crosses it; an autofocus box hunts in on the name, locks green and the shot flashes, with the exposure readout F1.8 1/250 ISO 125 25mm along the bottom. The role line types and rotates between full-stack developer, cloud infrastructure builder and visual creator. The line "I build web apps and the cloud systems that run them." fades in. On the right, a git commit graph draws itself from the first commit up to HEAD on main, with feat/web and infra/aws branches merging in; packets of light then travel up main and pulse on arrival at HEAD.
svg.text: I build web apps and the cloud systems that run them.
